risk.title: Heat risk now
risk.demo: DEMO: High heat is being simulated
tips.low: Drink water regularly, even if you are not thirsty.
Wear light, loose clothes and a hat.
tips.moderate: Drink a cup of water every 20 minutes.
Rest in the shade or a cool place every hour.
tips.high: Stay indoors or in the shade if you can.
Rest 15 minutes every hour. Drink water often.
Dizzy, confused or stopped sweating? Get help. Call 995.
home.nearestHint: Tap one for a cool route
home.seniorWelcome: Hello! Tap the big button to hear the heat advice.
speech.nearest: The nearest cool place is %{name}, %{dist} away.
spots.title: Cool places near you
spots.tapToPin: Tap the map where it feels hot
spots.howHot: How hot does it feel here?
spots.saved: Thanks! Your report is on the heat map.
spots.mapShowing: The map shows the %{n} nearest places.
spots.legend: Coloured circles = hot spots reported by users (last 24 h)
routes.tapDestination: Tap the map to choose where you are going
routes.error: Could not plan a route. Try another place.
routes.highWarning: Heat is HIGH. Rest at each green stop for 10–15 minutes.
chat.title: Ask CoolDrift
chat.welcome: Ask if it is safe to go out, how hot it is, or where to cool down.
chat.q.safe: Is it safe to go out?
chat.q.nearest: Where is the nearest cool place?
chat.a.safe_low: Yes. Heat risk is LOW right now. Still bring water and a hat.
chat.a.safe_moderate: Be careful. Heat risk is MODERATE. Go out if needed, rest in the shade every hour and drink water.
chat.a.safe_high: Better not, if you can wait. Heat risk is HIGH. If you must go out, use a Cool Route and rest often.
chat.a.nearest: The nearest cool place is %{name} (%{type} · %{cooling}), about %{dist} away. %{note}
chat.a.noData: Sorry, I have no weather data right now. Please check your internet.
chat.a.water: Drink a cup of water every 15–20 minutes when it is hot. Water points and hawker centres are on the Cool Spots map.
chat.a.route: Open the Routes tab and tap where you want to go. I will find a path past cool places.
chat.a.emergency: Feeling unwell from heat? Stop, move to a cool place, drink water. If very sick or confused, call 995 now.
chat.a.hello: Hello! I can tell you if it is safe to go out, the temperature, or the nearest cool place.
chat.a.unknown: Sorry, I did not understand. Try asking: "Is it safe to go out?"
settings.seniorDesc: Simple home screen, huge text, reads advice aloud.
settings.highAlertDesc: Notify + vibrate when heat risk becomes High.
settings.workerDesc: Reminds you to rest and drink water when heat is Moderate or High. Uses sound, vibration and voice.
settings.demoDesc: For showing judges. Pretends the heat risk is High.
settings.privacy: No account and no login. Your location stays on this phone. Only start and end points are sent to the free OpenStreetMap routing server when you ask for a route.
settings.notifDenied: Notifications are blocked. Please allow them in your phone settings.
notif.highBody: Heat risk is HIGH near you. Rest in a cool place and drink water.
notif.restBody: Rest in the shade for 10 minutes and drink a cup of water.
notif.restSpeech: Time for a break. Please rest in the shade and drink some water.
